div.div:
مُجْرٍ and مُجْرِيَةٌ applied to a bitch, (S, K,) and a female beast of prey, (TA,) Having a whelp, or young one: (K:) or having with her her whelps, or young ones. (S.) El-Aalam says, “لَحْمِى إِلَى أَجْرٍ حَوَاشِبْ
وَتَجُرُّ مُجْرِيَةٌ لَهَا
” And a hyena having young ones shall drag for her my flesh to young ones with swollen bellies, and short. (Skr p. 57.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
